mapper.sql: select hr.registration_id, hr.registration_no, hp.patient_name, hp.patient_code, hp.phone as patient_phone, hd.department_name, hdoc.doctor_name, hr.registration_time, hr.visit_date, hr.time_slot, hs.location, hr.status from hospital_registration hr left join hospital_patient hp on hr.patient_id = hp.patient_id left join hospital_department hd on hr.department_id = hd.department_id left join hospital_doctor hdoc on hr.doctor_id = hdoc.doctor_id left join hospital_schedule hs on hr.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id
mapper.select: select hdoc.doctor_id, hdoc.department_id, hd.department_name, hdoc.doctor_code, hdoc.doctor_name from hospital_doctor hdoc left join hospital_department hd on hdoc.department_id = hd.department_id where hdoc.del_flag = '0' and hdoc.doctor_id = #{doctorId} limit 1

select hdoc.doctor_id, hdoc.department_id, hd.department_name, hdoc.doctor_code, hdoc.doctor_name from hospital_doctor hdoc left join hospital_department hd on hdoc.department_id = hd.department_id where hdoc.del_flag = '0' and hdoc.user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select hs.schedule_id, hss.source_id, hs.schedule_date, hs.time_slot, hs.location, coalesce(hss.total_num, 0) as total_num, coalesce(hss.remain_num, 0) as remain_num, hss.status as source_status from hospital_schedule hs left join hospital_schedule_source hss on hs.schedule_id = hss.schedule_id and hss.del_flag = '0' where hs.del_flag = '0' and hs.doctor_id = #{doctorId} and hs.schedule_date = #{visitDate} order by hs.time_slot asc, hs.schedule_id asc

select hvr.visit_id, hr.registration_no, hp.patient_name, hp.phone as patient_phone, hvr.visit_time, hvr.chief_complaint, hvr.diagnosis, hvr.status from hospital_visit_record hvr left join hospital_registration hr on hvr.registration_id = hr.registration_id left join hospital_patient hp on hvr.patient_id = hp.patient_id where hvr.del_flag = '0' and hvr.doctor_id = #{doctorId} order by hvr.visit_time desc, hvr.visit_id desc limit 8
